svg.aria-label: Architecture of the Level 3 job market pipeline
svg.text: Two sources, an AI enrichment step, one warehouse, and history kept with SCD Type 2
The two extracts run in parallel. dbt only starts once both have finished and the AI step is done.
Also repairs garbled text (UTF-8 read as the wrong encoding) before saving
1. Pick jobs with no answer yet
Quote must be in the posting
Each job is read only once
Reads raw_remoteok_jobs for jobs without an answer, writes raw_job_enrichment
one local file: warehouse.duckdb (free, works with dbt)
the AI's answers, one row per job
by becomes author, unix time to timestamp
MARTS (dbt tables, ready to ask questions)
open jobs with the AI's findings attached
how many open jobs ask for each skill
one row per version of a listing
Data quality gates: dbt test + source freshness
a yes/no needs a real quote
RemoteOK table must not be empty
Built and verified on real data
